notes: Qaran, Marwan and Yazid form one level: «حدثنا قران ...، ومروان ...، ويزيد ...، عن سعيد» gives them as co-transmitters of Sa'id
Mughira is the last link: he speaks «أما إني سمعت رسول الله»; Ali b. Rabi'a narrates the story before him
Tirmidhi's remarks («قال أبو عيسى») and the «وفي الباب» list are not chain
